name: areBackupsEnabledForCriticalSystems
definition: Every Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud machine visible to the API client has a machine-backup policy (policy.backup.machine) whose last successful run is within the last 7 days. The vendor has no notion of a critical machine, so every machine counts as critical.
population: machines (resource.machine) returned by the Resource Management API, all pages
evidenceRequiredForTrue: every machine in a complete read has a machine-backup policy with last_success_run within 7 days

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.
